Name: Vanilla Rabbit Variants
Author: PilviShizik
Description:
This mod contains 10 recolors for the original rabbit sprite, it also assignes them randomly to a new bought rabbit.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[*]To change the default rabbit skin go to config.json. Replace the name with one other from the list.
One of 10 skins will be assigned randomly to a new bought rabbit, already existing rabbits will be default. You can write the skins you like or leave it blank.

OR

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install the latest version of Generic Mod Config[/url]. This mod helps to not restart the game every time in order to apply the changes. Be careful, as this can sometimes cause minor bugs if the game was not restarted.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.
[/list]
